Stripe._comment: Bangalore site. Mutton (2x/month) and fish (1x/week) are NOT configured: the Bangalore ontology carries zero mutton and zero fish dishes, so a rule would be inert and a pin would print a dish the kitchen has no entry for. Needs data first. 'Biryani on Wednesday' needs no rule — Wednesday is already the biryani theme day from the default theme map.
